anatomy.demo_en: View usage documentation ↗

parts.desc: 整段可点击区域，要通过文字样式、悬停和焦点状态让人看得出可以打开
parts.desc_en: The full clickable area; text styling, hover, and focus states should make its behavior recognizable

parts.desc: 说清楚点了去哪，别写“点击这里”
parts.desc_en: Says where the click takes you; never write “click here”

parts.desc: 可选，↗ 表示会离开本站
parts.desc_en: Optional, ↗ marks that you're leaving the site

variants.demo_en: See the help docs for details
variants.when: 正文中间跳资料，不打断阅读
variants.when_en: Jump to references mid-sentence without breaking the reading flow

variants.when: 单独一行做次级入口，如查看全部
variants.when_en: A secondary entry on its own line, like view all

variants.when: 会跳到站外时用它，记得带 ↗
variants.when_en: Use when the destination is off-site — remember the ↗

variants.when: 收起、换一批这类不重要的跳转
variants.when_en: Low-stakes jumps like collapse or show another batch

use.t: 页面之间跳转：去详情页、去设置页
正文里引用资料：协议、文档，不打断阅读节奏
次级入口：列表末尾的“查看详情 →”
跳到外部网站：加 ↗ 告诉别人会离开本站

dont.t: 需要执行操作，如提交、删除、保存：使用 {c:button}
整段文字都做成链接，点击范围过大且链接目的不清楚
文案只写“点击这里”，不说点了去哪
做成和普通文字一样，用户难以辨认它可以点击

lessonPractice.title: 订单号点开后要进入独立详情页，网址可复制，也能用浏览器返回。怎样实现最合适？

options.label: 把订单号做成指向详情地址的链接
options.feedback: 链接会表达明确目的地，同时保留复制地址、浏览器返回和键盘访问能力。

options.label: 用按钮在当前列表下方展开详情
options.feedback: 按钮适合执行当前页动作，但展开内容不会形成可复制的独立详情地址。

options.label: 给普通文字绑定点击并替换当前内容
options.feedback: 普通文字缺少链接语义，也容易丢失地址、焦点和浏览器导航能力。

en.title: Clicking an order number should open its own detail page with a copyable URL and browser Back support. What fits best?

options.label: Make the order number a link to the detail URL
options.feedback: A link provides a real destination plus URL copying, browser history, and keyboard access.

options.label: Use a button to expand details below the current list
options.feedback: A button can reveal content, but it does not provide the independent, copyable destination requested.

options.label: Attach a click handler to plain text and replace the page content
options.feedback: Plain clickable text lacks link semantics and can lose URL, focus, and browser navigation behavior.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 把订单号改成指向对应详情地址的链接，不要用普通文字绑定点击。请验证链接可用键盘聚焦、可复制地址，并且进入详情后浏览器返回能回到订单列表。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Turn each order number into a link to its detail URL instead of attaching a click handler to plain text. Verify keyboard focus, URL copying, and browser Back returning to the order list.

Three habits for better prompts

Before diving in, skim the component gallery first, look up unfamiliar terms in the official docs ↗ anytime, then come back and keep going.

Read the full article →

use.t: Jump to a section on the current page
Open documentation or a referenced source

dont.t: Use a link to submit, save, or delete data
Write only “click here” without naming the destination
Style it like plain text so people miss it
Open a new tab without a reason or a visible hint
